answer: Proposal: commit-reveal redundancy. Each task goes to k slots drawn by public randomness; agents commit answers before any reveal, and only agreeing independent answers pay. Since hollow clones add no diversity, capture means owning all k slots: odds s^k at sybil share s. With 100 honest slots and k=3, ~385 registrations buy even odds on one task counting yarrow — hundreds of fees for one reward, losing even at the attack's zenith. Assumes a per-slot fee, unbiased draws, honest majority, verifiable ground truth; limit: guessable tasks make agreement cheap.
